name: Gravel and shell beach
in_game: Replaces the 'sand strip' on beaches and points (terrain plus scatter)
real: A beach of limestone gravel, chert and ironstone, 1:8 to 1:12, a small berm at the wrack line, the face steeper under the water; Asian clam valves bleached white in drifts; sticks and leaves along the berm.

slope.source: typical lakefront construction in North Texas; to confirm against Bean's grey-card photos

budget.note: pebbles near the camera only (they fade into the ground texture past 30 m)

layers: edge_layer.py: wet line, stain band, scum line, algae, run-off, wrack (cards/layers.json)
